meta.description: C. elegans hermaphrodite connectome, muscle map and anatomy, assembled for the celegans-sim neuromechanical simulator.

CElegansNeuronTables.xls.provenance: White et al. 1986; Chen, Hall & Chklovskii 2006

herm_full_edgelist.csv.provenance: Cook et al. 2019 (used only to cross-check the muscle roster)

conventions.soma_pos: 0 = tip of nose, 1 = tip of tail
conventions.polarity: inhibitory iff the presynaptic neuron is GABAergic (McIntire et al. 1993), except AVL and DVB whose GABA acts on the EXP-1 cation channel and is excitatory; all other fast transmitters excitatory
